title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: Your idea of this evening, by the advisor: keep 10% of the week for Monday morning, every week? The session paces itself to a straight line from 0% at Monday 13:00 to 90% the next Monday 07:00 (about 58% at Friday 21:00), checked each hour. Up to 3 points ahead: carry on. 3 to 6 ahead: at most two helpers. More than 6 ahead: finish the item in hand and start no new session until back on the line. Behind: full pace within your rules. Monday 07:00 to 13:00: full pace, the last 10% shared with you.
sections.recommendation: Yes: the week reaches Monday without running out early. 62% at 22:10, against about 58% on the line.
